areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Core objective of expanding early-childhood access and quality, with infrastructure, quality standards and teacher training; indicators aligned and nearly all resources serve it.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Riverside-community education centers give meaningful access, but no direct link of the general objective to the area.

areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: Only indirect benefit via school meals; no components, products, goals or resources directly tied to the area.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: No direct correlation with the general objective; contribution is only collateral through wider school access.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Only indirect, secondary contribution via caregivers' labor-market entry; no resources for specific women's policies.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Only a teacher-training goal touches the theme indirectly; resources minimal and no specific goals.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Sustainable construction practices are instrumental; no indicators measure environmental results.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Impacts are local to the municipality; no regional-scale intervention reducing inter-regional inequality.
